about.title: About
about.subtitle: I am Emmanuel ADANDE
about.text: Passionate about technological innovation and visual design, I am a developer and designer dedicated to creating custom applications. I create comprehensive digital experiences that combine robust software architecture with elegant user interfaces. Specializing in modern technologies like React.js, C#, and Java, I design solutions that are both high-performing and visually striking. My approach merges programming rigor with a minimalist aesthetic to transform complex concepts into intuitive digital products.

projects.title: Mechantcharo-guilde
projects.desc: Web application for the management and administration of a Free Fire game guild, which also includes esports tournaments.

projects.title: Innovapdf
projects.desc: Full-stack SaaS web application dedicated to creating, AI-optimizing, and exporting high-fidelity PDF documents (resumes, invoices, quotes, etc.). The tool features a responsive visual editor with instant A4 preview. Tech Stack: Laravel 11+, Vue.js 3 (Composition API), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Inertia.js, AI API (Groq/Gemini), Dompdf/Puppeteer.

projects.title: Room Booking
projects.desc: Frontend Development (C#): Collaborated on the user interface design for a desktop application used for room management and reservations (meetings, conferences), including an admin dashboard.

projects.title: Project clubvideo
projects.desc: Java Development: Created a desktop application for tracking sales (cassettes), including secure role-based access control (employee / admin).

projects.title: Assigame
projects.desc: Contributed to the development of an online sales application. Designed the client interface (HTML/CSS/JS) and integrated it with a backend architecture using Java Spring Boot, backed by a relational database (PostgreSQL).

projects.title: Portfolio
projects.desc: Frontend Development (React.js): Created a personal portfolio website to showcase skills, projects, and professional experiences. The site is designed to be responsive and optimized for performance, with smooth navigation and interactive animations.
